title: A simple strategy that performs remarkably consistently.
author: Ok-Basil2753
selftext:
Starting the month with a principal of 30,000 and adding today’s profit of 45,000, my total return has reached 350,000. This is undoubtedly an impressive winning streak.

My trading strategy is highly systematic, encompassing ascending triangle breakouts confirmed by volume, double top and double bottom patterns, flag (and pennant) patterns, and volatility contraction confirmed by ATR (Average True Range). Furthermore, the strategy employs 5-day, 13-day, 34-day, and 55-day moving averages for multi stage trend verification, thereby integrating analysis across short, medium, and long term timeframes.

My goal isn't a 100% win rate; instead, I focus on keeping losses manageable and driving asset growth through profitable trades.

There are no shortcuts in trading. You must constantly overcome weaknesses, leverage your strengths, and persist in repeating this process.

I run a stock discussion group where I share daily market insights for free, covering stock selection logic, risk warnings, trading opportunities, and entry points. I share my strategies and experiences at no cost, hoping to help those eager to learn, seeking inspiration, or looking for different perspectives on achieving financial freedom. If you are also pursuing financial freedom, feel free to reach out or share your thoughts I am always happy to exchange ideas and grow together.

Please note that this post does not constitute investment advice; I read and reply to every comment and private message.

Happy trading to everyone!
